@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+
+from slatepress.frontmatter import parse_front_matter
+from slatepress.markdown import render_markdown
+from slatepress.html import render_html
+
+
+def build_site(source_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Converts Markdown files (.md) to HTML using front matter, markdown, and html modules,
+    recursing into subdirectories, skipping any file or directory whose name begins with
+    an underscore or a dot, and copying any non-Markdown file unchanged.
+
+    Returns a list of output file paths written as strings.
+    """
+    written_files: list[str] = []
+
+    source_path = Path(source_dir)
+    output_path = Path(output_dir)
+
+    if not source_path.exists():
+        return written_files
+
+    def _should_skip(path: Path, root: Path) -> bool:
+        # Check if any component relative to root starts with _ or .
+        try:
+            rel = path.relative_to(root)
+        except ValueError:
+            rel = path
+        for part in rel.parts:
+            if part.startswith("_") or part.startswith("."):
+                return True
+        return False
+
+    # Ensure output directory exists if source exists and is not empty
+    output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    for item in source_path.rglob("*"):
+        if _should_skip(item, source_path):
+            continue
+
+        if item.is_dir():
+            continue
+
+        rel_path = item.relative_to(source_path)
+
+        if item.suffix.lower() == ".md":
+            # Change extension to .html
+            out_rel = rel_path.with_suffix(".html")
+            out_file = output_path / out_rel
+
+            # Read markdown file content
+            content = item.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+            metadata, body = parse_front_matter(content)
+            html_content = render_markdown(body)
+            final_html = render_html(html_content, metadata)
+
+            out_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            out_file.write_text(final_html, encoding="utf-8")
+            written_files.append(str(out_file))
+        else:
+            out_file = output_path / rel_path
+            out_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            shutil.copy2(item, out_file)
+            written_files.append(str(out_file))
+
+    return sorted(written_files)
